messages:
maria.g: Quick question  we need to finalize retention tiers for security logs. Who signs off on long-term (7y) vs 90d? Also need flow for KMS unwraps during incidents. Is there a safelist for SIEM exports so SREs can access scrubbed data without key unwrap? @samir @alex.k

alex.k: Decision authority is Security + Compliance for 7y. Practically we need a tag->retention table. Suggest: forensics=7y, auth=1y, telemetry=90d. Prod owners must opt in for forensics. For KMS, use a proxy/unwrapper service; don't grant users kms:Decrypt.

samir: Agree. Proposal for unwraps: (a) incident ticket + justification, (b) sec-oncall approval recorded, (c) STS issues temp role 'kms-unwrapper' valid 30-60m, (d) temp role calls proxy which does KMS Decrypt and returns blobs. Proxy logs to audit bucket. Add OPA policy check pre-STS to constrain scope.

jess: Compliance: any 7y retention needs documented legal/compliance justification per tenant and retention justification stored in onboarding artifacts. Also require immutable audit trail for unwraps (who, why, TTL, approver).

oncall: Manual process is slow during P1s. Can we have an "urgent unwrap" fast-path that still requires human approval but automates STS/token issuance? Need a short checklist to avoid misuse.

infra: On SIEM export side we can emit tokenized, scrubbed exports with time-limited read-only tokens. That avoids unwraps for most consumers. Reserve unwrap for raw forensic pulls only.

alex.k: Minimal runbook sketch:
1) Create incident ticket with ID, scope, justification
2) Sec-oncall approves in Slack (reaction + link) -> system records approval
3) Automated system calls OPA policy, issues STS temp creds limited to proxy invocation
4) User calls proxy endpoint with creds + ticket ID
5) Proxy calls KMS Decrypt, writes audit JSON to audit/unwraps/<incident-id>.json, returns data blob
6) Token TTL enforced, CMK key version recorded and rotated regularly

samir: Also ensure proxy denies requests outside scope; do not return keys or raw plaintext unless explicitly approved. Keep per-request metadata: approver, approver-ts, requestor, requestor-attrs, ticket-link.

devsecops-bot: PR #1301 modifies retention-buckets.tf  security review requested from @eng-security.

jess: Action item: add retention justification to onboarding checklist, define approval template, and require upload of justification to audit path.

maria.g: Thanks. Action items: alex -> draft tag->bucket mapping + runbook; samir -> KMS proxy role + OPA policies draft; jess -> compliance checklist and onboarding changes; infra -> tokenized SIEM export design; devsecops-bot -> block PR until security review. Will follow up with draft doc. :thumbsup:
